fills.researcher_notes: Row is one of SNGPL's 'AV29-N2 / N2-Sahiwal / AV29-Sahiwal' RLNG spur segments running Qadirpur Ran -> Mian Channu -> Sahiwal, i.e. the trunk carrying imported RLNG north from the Sindh interconnection into central Punjab. Dawn (independent, verified) and SNGPL's own house newsletter (primary, verified live+read) both describe ONE project: PM Shahid Khaqan Abbasi inaugurated 'the largest ever transmission system augmentation project for RLNG supply' on 6 Jan 2018 near Bhong/Rahim Yar Khan, comprising 1,469 km total (SNGPL portion 1,044 km of 16"-42" pipe + 425 km SSGCL) at a cost of Rs 65 billion, doubling import capacity 1,200->2,400 mmcfd; the newsletter adds that SNGPL 'designed Project X for system augmentation/spur lines' for this exact 1,044 km figure and that the PM credited SNGPL/SSGC for completing it 'within two and half years' of launch. The two sources independently agree on the 1,044 km / Rs 65bn / Jan-2018 figures, which is real corroboration of the PROJECT-level completion date. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: neither source names this specific segment (AV29-N2) or gives a segment-level date — the StartYear1=2018 here is inferred from project-level completion, not a segment-specific citation, which is why tier is medium rather than high (per protocol § on field-vs-pipeline dates, a project-wide date is not automatically identical to a component's date, though here the geography (Qadirpur->Punjab, the exact corridor these RLNG spur lines run) and the diameter range (16"-42", covering this row's 24") both match closely). No SNGPL/OGRA document naming this segment by its AV-29/N2 station codes specifically was found (searched SNGPL, OGRA, Business Recorder, Dawn, Tribune via DuckDuckGo/Bing — all hits are either GEM's own wiki pages or unrelated). A human should treat 2018 as a well-supported project-completion year rather than a verbatim-cited segment commissioning date. HIGH-VALUE LEAD for the whole cluster (and worth flagging for other Pakistan-gas rows too): SNGPL's Jan-2018 house newsletter at the URL above is a searchable/readable primary source once rendered as images (pdftoppm/OCR) — page 6-7 'Cover Story' is the RLNG augmentation article; other issues of the same newsletter series (www.sngpl.com.pk/SNG_Megzines/...) may cover other segments/years and are worth a follow-up pass.
